papers.title: Proportional Multiaxial Fatigue Behavior and Life Prediction of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Ti-6Al-4V with Critical Plane-Based Building Direction Variations
papers.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) is an additive manufacturing technique that enables the fabrication of complex geometries through a layer-by-layer approach, overcoming limitations of conventional manufacturing. In this study, multiaxial low-cycle fatigue (MLCF) tests were conducted on L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) specimens built in four different orientations, selected based on critical plane orientations identified from rolled titanium. Under proportional strain-controlled loading, the cyclic softening behavior, mean stress response, and fracture mechanisms of the material were systematically investigated. The results show that L-PBF Ti64 exhibits a three-stage softening characteristic (continuous softening, stable, and rapid softening). Fatigue cracks primarily initiate from inner-surface lack-of-fusion defects. Crack propagation shows cleavage and quasi-cleavage characteristics with tearing ridges, river patterns, and multi-directional striations. Proposed KBMP life prediction model, incorporating λ and building direction parameters, was developed. The KBMP-λ model demonstrates optimal accuracy, providing a reliable tool for the design of L-PBF titanium components subjected to complex multiaxial fatigue loading with relative errors within 20%.

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the multiaxial low-cycle fatigue behavior of laser powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V components fabricated with different build orientations.
summary_en.method: Proportional strain-controlled multiaxial fatigue tests were conducted, and a KBMP life prediction model incorporating building direction parameters (λ) was developed based on critical plane concepts.
summary_en.result: The material exhibits three-stage cyclic softening, fatigue cracks initiate from lack-of-fusion defects, and the proposed KBMP-λ model predicts fatigue life with relative errors within 20%.
summary_en.validation: Experimental multiaxial fatigue tests on specimens with four build orientations validated the model's predictive capability.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了退火Ti-6Al-4V合金的深冷循环和激光冲击喷丸后处理，与后处理控制方向高度相关。

summary_zh.motivation: 通过深冷循环和激光冲击处理提高退火Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 深冷循环和双面激光冲击喷丸结合涂层。
summary_zh.result: 显微组织改善，力学性能提升。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试（拉伸、硬度等）。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance mechanical properties of annealed Ti-6Al-4V through combined deep cryogenic cycling and laser shock peening treatments.
summary_en.method: Deep cryogenic cycling treatment followed by double-sided laser shock peening with a protective coating.
summary_en.result: Improved microstructure refinement and enhanced tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements.
